title: EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.14828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. translated_title: EvoCowork：一个面向真实世界办公任务的基准
translated_abstract: 办公工作流是检验自我改进智能体的严苛测试平台，因为其交付成果必须正确、原生可编辑且相互一致。一个核心问题是：在反馈任务上取得的收益，究竟反映了可复用的程序，还是仅仅是针对特定任务的临时修补。我们提出了 EvoCowork，一个包含240个任务的基准，用于在四种办公模态下评估 harness 级的递归自我改进能力，同时保持模型权重不变。该基准涵盖演示文稿、文档、电子表格以及跨办公应用的工作流，并对提交的成果从内容、原生结构、公式、跨文件一致性以及必要时的视觉质量等方面进行评分。其评估协议将反馈、修订选择和最终测试分离开来：方法先从单模态任务中学习，然后在共享的初始 harness 和明确的预算约束下，在未见过的单模态任务和跨办公工作流上进行评估。在对两个模型和四个 harness 的静态评估中，
tldr: EvoCowork 提出了一个涵盖演示文稿、文档、电子表格及跨应用工作流共240个任务的基准，在模型权重固定的情况下评估智能体 harness 级的递归自我改进能力，重点检验反馈驱动的提升能否转化为可复用的程序而非任务特定的修补。
en_tdlr: EvoCowork is a 240-task benchmark spanning presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows that evaluates harness-level recursive self-improvement with fixed model weights, testing whether feedback-driven gains reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes.
